title: Bug — refresh installed Vaporize CLI to match source Pkl exclusion semantics
description: The installed vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh generated a Disk Cleaner project that ignored the Pkl source exclusion for DiskCleanerV000000002App.swift, producing two @main entries. A newer source-built Vaporize binary honored that exclusion and generated four source files. The installed CLI must be refreshed through its owning source-gate and installation workflow; source-only success is not installed-runtime proof.
acceptanceCriteria: The source and installed Vaporize CLI generate equivalent Pkl source-exclusion results for the CUJ-14 exact and recursive exclusion fixtures.
The installed CLI generates the Disk Cleaner active project without DiskCleanerV000000002App.swift in its PBX sources phase.
The install receipt identifies source revision or binary digest, installed path, and post-install exclusion proof.
The CLI's owning i18n/source gates and installation controls pass; no direct binary replacement bypasses them.
A fresh generated Disk Cleaner project builds its focused topology suite without multiple @main failures.
risks: Using an older installed generator can make a valid Pkl exclusion appear ineffective, causing duplicate application entry points or stale build graphs.
Replacing the installed binary without its resource and source-gate workflow would create an untraceable runtime artifact.
A successful source-built tool is not evidence that the operator-default installed tool has the same behavior.

relatedRefs.t: Disk Cleaner affected single-project-manifest migration Bead
